      "violation_condition": "The user skips hand washing at start or finish, or fails to perform the inspection of the wound before applying the dressing.",
      "compliance_condition": "All ordered steps A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, and A8 are observed to be performed sequentially.",

        "relevant_entities": [
          "user",
          "soap",
          "hands",
          "gloves",
          "cut",
          "non-stick pad",
          "zip bag"
        ],
        "observable_cues": [
          "visual confirmation of hand washing motion",
          "presence of gloves on hands",
          "visual inspection of cut",
          "placement of pad",
          "sealing zip bag",
          "removal of gloves"
        ],

        "current_support": "unsupported",

          "System only provides 5-second interval snapshots, which are insufficient to verify entire procedural workflows or ensure no steps were skipped between samples."
        ]
      },
      "detection_timing": "Throughout procedure",
      "source_reference": "Original instruction linear sequence.",
      "limitations": [
        "Cannot guarantee continuity of actions across snapshots."
      ],
      "compliance_question": "Were all actions completed in the correct order?",
      "applicability_condition": "Procedure initiation.",
      "source": "explicit_instruction",
      "requires_expert_review": false
    }
  ],
  "review_notes": [
    "The current system capabilities (periodic RGB snapshots) are insufficient to verify clinical actions like hand washing (A1, A8), glove removal (A7), or a continuous inspection (A4) due to lack of temporal resolution and action-aligned video.",
    "The inspection criteria for the wound (A4) - specifically red, swollen, or leaking - are subjective clinical findings that a VLM cannot reliably diagnose from a single RGB image.",
    "The instruction 'Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut' implies a spatial requirement (coverage) that may be ambiguous depending on the angle of the provided snapshot."
  ]
}
